description: Defines a base class 'CustomDB' for custom database implementations with methods for data operations such as get, insert, update, delete, connect, and disconnect.

classes.name: CustomDB
classes.description: Implements a base class that we expect any custom db implementation (e.g. DynamoDB) to follow

methods.name: get_data(self, key: str, table_name: Literal["user", "key", "config"])
methods.description: Checks if the key is valid and retrieves data from the database.

methods.name: insert_data(self, value: Any, table_name: Literal["user", "key", "config"])
methods.description: Inserts new data into the database for a given key and table.

methods.name: update_data( self, key: str, value: Any, table_name: Literal["user", "key", "config"] )
methods.description: Updates existing data in the database for a specified key and table.

methods.name: delete_data( self, keys: List[str], table_name: Literal["user", "key", "config"] )
methods.description: Deletes data from the database for the specified list of keys.

methods.name: connect( self, )
methods.description: Establishes connection to the database and creates or updates tables.

methods.name: disconnect( self, )
methods.description: Closes the connection to the database.

ctags.name: get_data
ctags.pattern: /^    def get_data(self, key: str, table_name: Literal["user", "key", "config"]):$/

ctags.name: insert_data
ctags.pattern: /^    def insert_data(self, value: Any, table_name: Literal["user", "key", "config"]):$/

ctags.name: update_data
ctags.signature: ( self, key: str, value: Any, table_name: Literal["user", "key", "config"] )
